backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a contact form backend with admin-controlled submission viewing, user profile management, filtering/sorting logic, and role-based access control via AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no recorded features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and key content for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the React SPA titled 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', mounting the app at #root and loading the Vite entry point.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt file declaring a direct relationship with publisher ID pub-4905807488237044.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with eight routes (Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Resources, Contact, Donate, Admin) under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component rendering organization branding, quick navigation links, contact details (email, two phone numbers, location), and social media icons (Facebook, X, WhatsApp, YouTube).
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with a background image overlay, organization name, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission text, CTA buttons, and an animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that composes Navigation, a main content Outlet, and Footer into a full-height flex column for all pages.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying a Hindi heading, descriptive paragraph, and a four-card grid of core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) with icons.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation bar with desktop and mobile menus, active link highlighting, and a conditional admin link shown only to authenticated admin users via Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Simple card component that displays a Lucide icon, title, and description for a program entry with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Renders a 2x2 grid of support option cards (volunteer, awareness, skills, knowledge) each linking to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Hook managing contact form submission state (submitting, success, error) by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login, logout, and identity state with React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports React Query hooks for fetching all contact submissions, checking if the caller is an admin, and retrieving the current user's profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and defining a Sanatani-inspired warm (saffron/terracotta) color palette via CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes, plus Tailwind base/component/utility layers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page with a hero section, organization story text, and a grid of four principle cards (Purpose, Vision, Values, Community).
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that requires Internet Identity authentication and admin privileges to view, search, and export all contact form submissions as CSV.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a form (name, email, message) that submits via useContactForm hook, plus contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page displaying support options via SupportOptions component, a breakdown of fund allocation by impact area with progress bars, and a transparency section.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing Hero and Mission components with a highlights grid of four activity areas and a call-to-action section linking to donate and contact pages.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page presenting Sanatana Dharma teachings in Hindi and English, covering eternal nature, bhakti yoga, karma, and devotion examples from Hindu scripture.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page listing six initiative cards (Vedic study, festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) plus an impact statistics section.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: Renders the Resources page with a hero section and four resource category cards (Sacred Texts, Video Lectures, Articles & Essays, Downloadable Materials), each showing an icon, description, and list of items.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors (saffron, gold, etc.), display/serif font families, warm box shadows, and accordion/fade-in animations, using typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for a task to translate the entire app UI from English to Hindi, listing individual pending action requests (AR-1 through AR-13+) scoped to each page and component.
